title: Plan Summary Grid — Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Waiting Period, Deductible and Annual Maximum
content:
None of the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans has a waiting period, a deductible or an annual dollar maximum.

| Plan | Waiting period (months before any service is covered) | Deductible (USD) | Annual dollar maximum applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 0 | 0.00 | No |

**Meaning of each entry**

- *Waiting period* — months before any service is covered; 0 means none.
- *Deductible* — USD deductible; 0.00 means none.
- *Annual dollar maximum applies* — false (shown as No) means no annual dollar maximum.

**Consequences on every plan**

- Services are covered from the coverage effective date, with no months to wait: the waiting period is 0 months.
- No deductible amount is satisfied before scheduled copays apply: the deductible is 0.00.
- No annual dollar ceiling limits what the plan provides in a benefit year: no annual dollar maximum applies.
